summary: Phase 2 (customisable training/programmes) tested end-to-end. Backend: new tests/test_programmes.py (28 tests) + full regression (85 passed total incl. new file, -n 0 -k 'not preview and not cron_run'). Found & fixed one 500 (priorities with non-string values). UI (Alex via Clerk ticket, desktop 1920 + mobile 390): create programme from split, rename programme/days, toggle muscle groups, Add exercise select (day's muscles listed first), keyboard dnd reorder (Space/ArrowDown/Space) and mouse drag reorder, remove exercise, move day up/down, duplicate/delete day, add training/rest day, Weekdays schedule + weekday selects + week strip, priorities + frequency counts, Save -> reload persists identical order, unsaved-changes confirm on tab switch (dismiss stays, accept switches and discards), duplicate programme, delete with confirm dialog, Set as active -> Home Active plan + Up next (weekly: Monday day; rotation: after logging 'Lower' Up next skipped rest -> 'Day 4'), Log 'Load a plan day' lists only training days, Log workout save works. Exercise library: 41 cards, Model 5 images all load, Glutes filter shows 3. Migration verified: Alex's 'Mass Phase' (default-<uid>, active) exercise_ids identical to /app/backups pre-phase2 backup. All test data cleaned up; Alex left with Mass Phase (active) + PPL Test.

minor.issue: FIXED: priorities {'Chest': ['primary']} raised TypeError (unhashable in set) -> 500. Changed PlanIn.priorities to Optional[Dict[str, str]] so bad types now return 422.
Not atomic (update_many deactivate then update_one activate); concurrent get_plan between the two could auto-activate the oldest programme. Low risk.
Rest days keep muscle_groups/exercise_ids if a training day is toggled to rest (stale data stored; harmless since rest is skipped everywhere).

integration_issues.flow: Editing then clicking Set as active / Duplicate while dirty (code review, not UI-reproduced)
integration_issues.issue: ProgrammeEditor has useEffect(() => setP(programme), [programme]); act() invalidates 'programmes' so the refetched object replaces local state and silently drops unsaved edits. Duplicate while dirty copies the last saved version and switches view without the discard confirm.

issues: Sticky save bar (~70px) stays on screen when there are no changes ('All changes saved' + disabled Save), covering content above the bottom nav. Consider showing it only when dirty.

action_items: Guard unsaved edits on Set as active / Duplicate (confirm or save first), or only re-sync editor state when not dirty
Optional: show the sticky save bar only when dirty on mobile
Optional: clear muscle_groups/exercise_ids on rest days in norm_day; make activate atomic
server.py is 785 lines (>700) - split programme routes into their own router module
critical_code_review_comments: PlanIn.priorities was an untyped dict -> 500 on non-string values (fixed)
ProgrammeEditor state re-sync on refetch can discard unsaved edits without prompt
